hero.title: Type-Safe i18n for Angular
hero.subtitle: A signal-based translation library with lazy namespace loading, recursive proxy for crash-free templates, and LLM-powered CLI tooling.

signal.title: Signal-Powered
signal.description: Reactive translations via Angular Signals. Zero Zone.js dependency. Works seamlessly with zoneless change detection.

proxy.title: Crash-Free Templates
proxy.description: Recursive proxy ensures expressions like t().nav.title never throw — even when namespaces are still loading.

ssr.title: SSR & SSG Ready
ssr.description: TransferState hydration prevents flash of untranslated content. Works with both server and static rendering.

lazy.title: Lazy Loading
lazy.description: Load translation namespaces on-demand per route. Only fetch what the user needs, when they need it.

types.title: Type-Safe Keys
types.description: CLI generates TypeScript types from your JSON files. Catch missing keys at compile time, not runtime.

llm.title: LLM Translation
llm.description: Built-in CLI command to batch-translate your JSON files using AI. Maintain consistent terminology across languages.

demo.title: See It In Action
demo.description: This entire documentation site uses angular-translation-service for its own i18n. Toggle the language switcher above to see real-time language switching — no page reload needed.
